title: Jets put DT T'Vondre Sweat on IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets put DT T'Vondre Sweat on IR
sources.description: The Jets ruled defensive tackle T'Vondre Sweat out for Week 8 on Friday and they ruled him out for at least three more games on Saturday.
